verdict.rationale: LibreChat has a dedicated 'Subagents' feature page and a 'Skills' page, plus an Agent Management API for creating/discovering/updating agents, and supports invoking agents via '@' mentions in chat — indicating built-in support for composing/orchestrating multiple agents rather than just single-agent chat. However, the evidence pack only gives page titles/snippets without detail on how work is split or parallelized across subagents, or any agent-to-agent protocol specifics. Missing for 10: concrete documentation/examples of task splitting or parallel execution across subagents, description of swarm/agent-to-agent messaging protocol, and independent hands-on verification of multi-agent orchestration in practice.
